title: adnaria oleifolia
intro: Adnaria oleifolia, commonly known as Adenaria oleifolia, is a plant species that belongs to the family Passifloraceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health. The bioactive constituents present in Adnaria oleifolia include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, antimicrobial, and anti-inflammatory activities. The health benefits of Adnaria oleifolia include its potential to lower blood pressure, improve lipid profiles, and provide protection against oxidative stress and cell damage.
